title: Rowena Goes Too Far
author: H. C. Asterley
current_text: In 1931, Australian customs banned Rowena Goes Too Far in Australia because it believed the novel “lacked sufficient claim to the literary to excuse the obscenity”.

sources.quote: His first novel, Rowena Goes Too Far was published in 1931. A bestseller in the UK, it was banned in Australia due to customs belief that it “lacked sufficient claim to the literary to excuse the obscenity”.
